prompt:
Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse.
Placement: article hero.
Subject: Choose document ingestion tools that preserve RAG source passages.
Verified context: A PDF text extractor cannot recover text from an image-only scan. Reading order, table structure and source locations need inspection before retrieval. This toolkit selects small local parsers or layout/OCR pipelines according to document needs.
Visual idea: A terracotta thread passes through a layered stack of chalky paper-like stone sheets, keeping separated fragments physically connected to their source.
Output crop: wide 16:9 article hero, high resolution.
Use docs/reference-layouts/story.html as placement source: wide art below headline, object-fit cover, generous whitespace, essential central motif survives mobile and card crop. This is an artwork asset, not a webpage.
Art direction: restrained contemporary editorial illustration, quiet scientific/architectural sensibility, deliberate geometry, fine supporting lines, subtle paper texture. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, ink #171B1A, gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious strong hierarchy; chalky material presence, overlapping planes, oblique spatial depth, directional soft shadows, lithographic grain like the inspected production references. The thread and layered sheets are one physical metaphor, not a literal technical mechanism.
No bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition or minimalist architecture diagram. Fine lines support material forms.
Depict only supported context; no implied benchmark or perfect extraction.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header/footer, buttons, badges, charts, watermark, neon, robots, glowing brains, headline or screenshot. No border or frame. Clean high-resolution output.
CRITICAL: All sheets are completely blank chalky stone slabs, with NO markings whatsoever, no printed pictures, no text-like lines, no maps, no grids, no diagrams or lines on their surfaces. Only stone texture. Keep horizontal landscape 16:9.
composition_prompts: A: low horizontal fanned layers and a central loop of thread.
B: upright fanned slabs and a central draped thread.
C: diagonal stepped slabs pierced by one taut thread.
